title: OpenSpore research-only testability map
scope: Inventory of existing tests, CTest targets, fixtures, differential tests, asset oracles, replacement diffs, runtime traces, and absent validation classes. No code changes and no destructive runtime experiments are included in this inventory.

method.execution_boundary: Static inventory only; ctest --test-dir build -N was used to enumerate registered tests. The test suite, Wine, Ghidra, build tools, and game binary were not run as part of this map.
method.status_semantics: Last-recorded status is copied from committed project records. It is not a fresh execution claim.

validation_taxonomy.deterministic_unit: Direct assertions or a fixed native/Python test executable with no proprietary asset, display, network, or game dependency.
validation_taxonomy.fixture_comparison: Compares a parser, replay, renderer, or tool against a committed synthetic or semantic expectation.
validation_taxonomy.decomp_differential: Compares a clean-room implementation with a reference transcribed from decompiler output; this is evidence-not-truth and not a live binary oracle.
validation_taxonomy.original_binary_oracle: Uses the original SporeApp.exe behavior under Wine or another faithful original-binary execution as the oracle.
validation_taxonomy.replacement_hook: Validates the inline-hook mechanism, ABI, control transfer, or replacement registration on a native controlled target.
validation_taxonomy.asset_driven: Loads real GOG assets or synthetic binary format fixtures and validates identity, structural fields, references, or decoded output.
validation_taxonomy.integration: Crosses a process, subprocess, JSON-RPC, HTTP, display, GPU, file, or environment boundary.
validation_taxonomy.not_yet_testable: The necessary fixture, original oracle, implementation seam, environment, or behavioral contract is absent or not reachable.

overall_conclusion.strongest_current_validation: Deterministic parser/simulation/app contracts, committed synthetic format fixtures, selected real GOG asset structural checks, 64/64 replacement-to-decompilation differential coverage, and extensive MCP/KG/automation safety coverage.
overall_conclusion.largest_evidence_boundary: Original SporeApp.exe cell-stage behavior and stage/resource transition behavior are not captured. The cell contract fixture is generated from OpenSpore, and the replacement reference is decompiler transcription rather than live truth.
overall_conclusion.highest_priority_gap: A stable, attributable original Cell Stage trace is the single artifact that would unlock the largest number of replaced-approx/inferred/approximated claims.
safe_reuse_order: attempt original runtime validation only when gated
